design.name: 丹炉傀
design.brief: A walking bronze alchemy furnace (丹炉) golem, the abbey's tank: a massive three-legged round bronze cauldron-furnace with a domed lid, two ring handles like ears, thick stubby tripod legs ending in beast paws, and two short heavy bronze arms with big fists bolted to its sides; a grim beast face cast on its belly. Its furnace door on the front glows with cold pale jade-green fire (weak spot, it opens when it breathes frost). Verdigris bronze with snow on the lid and frost crust on the legs, chains and talismans wrapped around it. Heavy, slow, unstoppable.
design.weapon: both fists raised to slam the ground, the furnace door glowing
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, paper and cloth as thick simple bands, fur as big carved clumps. Its defence is its own bronze body: it holds NO shield and NO weapon.
